projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
End-to-end analytics dashboard combining three data domains: (1) customer CSV file processing/ingestion, (2) application log analysis, and (3) visualization components. Scope covers requirements and architecture, ingestion pipelines, data storage/modeling, log parsing and aggregation, a reusable visualization component library, dashboard API integration, testing/hardening, and launch. Work is decomposed into milestones and small (complexity <= 6/10) executable tasks.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization, csv, logs

tasks.name: M1 — Requirements, KPIs & Architecture
tasks.details: Define what the dashboard must answer, profile the three data domains, and lock the target architecture before building. Gate for all downstream milestones.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing
tasks.details: Reliable, idempotent ingestion of customer CSV files: file intake, validation, cleaning, incremental upserts, and quarantine of bad rows.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Turn raw application logs into queryable metrics: canonical event schema, format parsers, checkpointed collection, aggregations, and anomaly detection.

tasks.name: M4 — Data Storage, Modeling & Orchestration
tasks.details: Land both data domains in a governed warehouse model and schedule the pipelines end to end with data quality gates.

tasks.name: M5 — Visualization Component Library
tasks.details: Build a reusable, themed, accessible chart and widget library that the dashboard screens compose from.

tasks.name: M6 — Dashboard Application & API Integration
tasks.details: Expose curated data through a stable query API and assemble the actual dashboard screens for customer and log analytics.

tasks.name: M7 — Testing, Data Quality & Observability
tasks.details: Prove the dashboard is correct, fast, and safe: end-to-end coverage, data quality alerting, pipeline/API monitoring, load and security review.

tasks.name: M8 — Deployment & Launch Readiness
tasks.details: Ship it: production pipeline, staging UAT, runbook and training, staged rollout with rollback plan and hypercare.

tasks.name: Inventory and profile customer CSV sources
tasks.details: List every CSV feed: owner, delivery method (SFTP/email/bucket), file naming, refresh cadence, approximate row volume, column list and data types. Flag PII columns. Output: CSV source inventory sheet. Done when every known feed has a row and a named owner.

tasks.name: Inventory and profile application log sources
tasks.details: For each service: log format (JSON/key-value/plaintext), levels, sample files, average events/day, retention policy, and whether multiline stack traces occur. Output: log source inventory with 20+ sample lines per service format.

tasks.name: Define KPIs, personas and dashboard use cases
tasks.details: Write down the 8-12 KPIs the dashboard must show (e.g. active customers, revenue per segment, error rate per service, p95 latency, request volume), who uses them, and the decision each supports. One KPI card = one definition with formula and source column. Done when stakeholders sign off.

tasks.name: Choose architecture and technology stack
tasks.details: Decide: batch vs streaming for logs, warehouse/lake choice, orchestration tool (e.g. Airflow/Dagster), query API stack, and frontend charting library. Capture trade-offs and cost implications in a short ADR. Done when the stack is agreed and no open blocking questions remain.

tasks.name: Set up repository, standards and CI skeleton
tasks.details: Create monorepo (or repos) for ingestion, api and frontend; add lint/format config, pre-commit hooks, branch protection, and a CI pipeline that runs lint + unit tests on every PR. Done when an empty PR passes CI green.

tasks.name: Architecture one-pager + stakeholder sign-off
tasks.details: Consolidate data flow diagram (CSV + logs -> storage -> API -> dashboard), KPI list, stack decision and milestone plan into a 1-2 page doc. Review with stakeholders; record sign-off and any deferred scope. This is the M1 exit gate.

tasks.name: CSV file intake and file-level tracking
tasks.details: Implement the intake step: watch/inbox a bucket or SFTP path, detect new files, record filename + checksum + received_at in a manifest table, and skip already-processed files (idempotency). Done when re-dropping the same file produces zero duplicate rows and a logged "skipped" event.

tasks.name: CSV schema detection and validation rules
tasks.details: Parse headers, map columns to the canonical customer schema, and enforce rules: required fields, expected types, date/currency formats, allowed enum values, max lengths. Emit a structured validation report per file. Done when a deliberately broken fixture fails with one clear error per bad row.

tasks.name: Normalization, de-duplication and PII masking
tasks.details: Standardize whitespace, casing, dates to UTC, currency to a single unit; trim and de-duplicate records by customer_id + effective_date; mask/hash PII columns flagged in the M1 inventory. Done when a raw fixture and its normalized output are diffed in a test.

tasks.name: Incremental customer upsert
tasks.details: Merge cleaned rows into the curated customer table keyed on customer_id + effective_date, with updated_at tracking and soft-delete handling. Done when a re-run is a no-op and a changed record updates exactly one row.

tasks.name: Quarantine and error reporting for rejected rows
tasks.details: Route invalid rows to a quarantine table with the original line, rule violated, and file reference; write a per-run summary (rows in / loaded / rejected) and expose it for alerting. Done when bad rows never reach the curated table but are fully recoverable from quarantine.

tasks.name: CSV pipeline test suite with golden fixtures
tasks.details: Build fixture files: happy path, missing column, wrong type, duplicate rows, mixed date formats, unicode names, empty file, 100k-row file. Assert load counts, quarantine counts and resulting table contents. Done when suite runs in CI in under 5 minutes.

tasks.name: Document the CSV contract and onboarding guide
tasks.details: Write the expected file format, column dictionary, validation rules, delivery cadence, quarantine process and who to contact. Include a downloadable template CSV. Done when a new source owner can self-serve onboarding from the doc alone.

tasks.name: Define canonical log event schema and parse rules
tasks.details: Specify the normalized event: timestamp (UTC), service, level, message, request_id, trace_id, latency_ms, status_code, error_type, raw. Document the mapping from each source format in the M1 inventory. Done when every source has an explicit field-by-field mapping.

tasks.name: Log collector with checkpointing
tasks.details: Ingest log files/streams from the configured sources, track the last processed offset or file position per source, and resume safely after a restart. Done when killing the collector mid-batch and restarting produces no gaps and no duplicates.

tasks.name: JSON / structured log parser
tasks.details: Parse structured log lines into the canonical event schema, with field aliases for services that name things differently. Unknown fields go into an attributes map, not dropped. Done when 100 sample structured lines parse with zero loss of original content.

tasks.name: Plaintext / regex log parser
tasks.details: Implement regex-based parsing for plaintext formats with named capture groups for timestamp, level, service and message. Handle timezone offsets and odd separators. Done when the unparseable rate on real sample files is under 1% and those failures are logged.

tasks.name: Multiline stack-trace handling
tasks.details: Detect continuation lines (stack frames, "Caused by") and stitch them to the originating event so one exception is one record. Cap stored trace length and hash it for grouping. Done when a 200-line stack trace becomes a single event with a stable error fingerprint.

tasks.name: Log aggregation rollups
tasks.details: Build per-minute and per-hour rollups: request count, error count/rate by service and level, and latency percentiles. Write to aggregate tables partitioned by day. Done when rollup numbers reconcile with a hand-counted sample of raw events.

tasks.name: Baseline anomaly detection for error spikes
tasks.details: Compute a rolling 7-day baseline per service and flag when the current error rate exceeds a configurable threshold (e.g. 3x baseline) for 5+ minutes. Store flags with severity; no paging yet. Done when seeded spike data produces a flag and normal traffic does not.

tasks.name: Log retention, partitioning and PII scrubbing
tasks.details: Partition raw and aggregate log tables by day, set retention (e.g. 30 days raw / 13 months aggregates) with an automated purge job, and scrub emails, tokens and IPs from stored messages. Done when a purge dry-run lists the expected partitions and a scan finds no raw PII.

tasks.name: Log pipeline test suite (sample + malformed logs)
tasks.details: Fixtures for each format plus malformed input: truncated line, bad timestamp, invalid JSON, mixed line endings, empty file, huge line. Assert parsed counts, unparseable rate and error fingerprints. Done when suite is green in CI and covers every parser branch.

tasks.name: Design warehouse schema
tasks.details: Define layers (raw/staging/curated), fact and dimension tables for customer and log metrics, the grain of each fact, surrogate keys and naming conventions. Include a simple ER diagram. Done when every KPI from M1 maps to a column and table.

tasks.name: Create tables, views and migrations
tasks.details: Write versioned migration scripts for all raw, staging and curated objects plus the dashboard-facing views. Include a rollback path per migration. Done when migrations apply cleanly to an empty database and can be reverted.

tasks.name: Orchestration DAGs for CSV and log pipelines
tasks.details: Define scheduled workflows with correct ordering (intake -> validate -> transform -> load -> aggregate), retries with backoff, timeouts and failure notifications. Keep tasks idempotent. Done when both pipelines run end to end on a schedule in staging.

tasks.name: Data quality gates (freshness, counts, integrity)
tasks.details: Add automated checks after each load: freshness within SLA, row-count within expected band vs prior runs, no nulls in required keys, referential integrity to dimensions, no duplicate keys. Fail the run (loudly) when checks fail. Done when a seeded bad batch is blocked.

tasks.name: Dev/staging/prod environments and secrets management
tasks.details: Provision separate databases/buckets per environment with least-privilege service accounts. All credentials in a secret manager, never in code; config via environment variables. Done when the pipelines run in staging with rotated credentials and no secrets in the repo.

tasks.name: Component library scaffolding
tasks.details: Create the component package: TypeScript config, build setup, folder structure, lint rules, and one trivial component to prove the pipeline. Done when the package builds and its test passes in CI.

tasks.name: Line and area chart components
tasks.details: Build time-series line and area charts with axes, gridlines, tooltips, legend, multiple series, and consistent number/date formatting. Accept a typed data prop. Done when Storybook shows 1, 3 and 10-series examples without overlap or clipping.

tasks.name: Bar and stacked-bar chart components
tasks.details: Build vertical/horizontal bar and stacked-bar charts for segment comparisons (e.g. customers by region, errors by service). Handle long category labels, sorting and value labels. Done when examples render correctly at mobile and desktop widths.

tasks.name: KPI stat cards and data table component
tasks.details: Build KPI cards (value, trend arrow, comparison period, optional sparkline) and a table with sorting, pagination, column alignment, and numeric formatting. Done when both handle loading of 0, 1 and 500 rows predictably.

tasks.name: Loading, empty and error states + responsive layout primitives
tasks.details: Shared skeletons, empty-state messaging ("no data for this period"), and error/retry components. Add a responsive grid with defined breakpoints and card sizing. Done when every chart story shows all three states and reflows at 375px / 768px / 1440px.

tasks.name: Accessibility pass on all components
tasks.details: Keyboard navigation, focus states, ARIA roles/labels for charts, table headers, and text alternatives for color-only encoding; verify contrast ratios against the palette. Run axe on every story. Done when zero critical axe violations remain.

tasks.name: Component documentation and usage examples
tasks.details: For each exported component: props table, do/don't guidance, and a copy-paste example. Document the chart color rules (max series, categorical vs sequential). Done when a developer can add a new chart to a page without reading the source.

tasks.name: Define API contract and OpenAPI spec
tasks.details: Specify endpoints, query params (date range, granularity, filters), response shapes, error format and pagination model. Generate the OpenAPI document and a typed client. Done when the spec validates and the frontend can be coded against mocks.

tasks.name: KPI and time-series query endpoints
tasks.details: Implement endpoints returning KPI values with period-over-period comparison and time-series points at the requested granularity. Push aggregation into SQL, not the app. Done when responses match directly-run SQL for the same range.

tasks.name: Customer and log aggregate query endpoints
tasks.details: Endpoints for customer segments/cohorts, top-N tables, error breakdown by service, slowest endpoints, and error-fingerprint drilldown. Validate all filter inputs and cap result sizes. Done when each endpoint has contract tests against seeded data.

tasks.name: Query caching and pagination
tasks.details: Cache expensive aggregate queries with a short TTL keyed by query params, add ETag or stale-while-revalidate where useful, and implement cursor/offset pagination for table endpoints. Done when repeated identical queries hit cache and large tables page without full scans.

tasks.name: Dashboard shell, routing and layout
tasks.details: Set up the app shell: navigation between Customer Analytics and Log Analytics, page header, breadcrumbs, route structure, code splitting, and a data-fetching layer (query client) with retries. Done when both routes render placeholder pages with navigation working.

tasks.name: Customer analytics screens
tasks.details: Assemble the customer overview: KPI row, customer growth trend, segment breakdown, and top-customers table, wired to the API with loading/empty/error states. Done when screen matches the KPI definitions from M1 on seeded data.

tasks.name: Log analytics screens
tasks.details: Assemble the log overview: request volume, error-rate trend, latency percentiles, error breakdown by service, and error-fingerprint drilldown table. Wire to API with all UI states. Done when a known seeded incident is visible end to end.

tasks.name: Global filters and shareable URL state
tasks.details: Date-range presets plus custom range, service and customer-segment filters, and optional compare-to-previous-period. Persist state in the URL so a filtered view can be shared/bookmarked. Done when loading a copied URL reproduces the exact view.

tasks.name: End-to-end tests for critical dashboard journeys
tasks.details: Cover: load dashboard, change date range, filter by service, drill into an error fingerprint, and open a shared URL. Run against seeded staging data in CI. Done when the suite passes consistently (no flakes across 10 runs).

tasks.name: Data quality monitoring and alerting
tasks.details: Emit metrics for every quality gate (freshness, rejected-row rate, null-key count) and alert to the team channel when a threshold is breached. Include a weekly data quality summary. Done when a failed test batch triggers an alert within 5 minutes.

tasks.name: Pipeline and API observability (metrics, logs, alerts)
tasks.details: Instrument pipeline runs (duration, success/fail, rows processed, lag) and API endpoints (latency, error rate, cache hit rate). Build two dashboards and alert thresholds for pipeline failure, stale data and API p95 breaches. Done when a forced failure is visible and alerts fire.

tasks.name: Performance and load test of API and dashboard
tasks.details: Define targets (e.g. dashboard TTI under 3s, API p95 under 800ms at 50 concurrent users). Load-test the heaviest queries, profile slow SQL, add indexes as needed, and test the frontend with throttled network. Done when targets are met and documented.

tasks.name: Security and privacy review
tasks.details: Check authentication/authorization on dashboard and API, PII handling and masking, secret storage, SQL injection surface, dependency vulnerabilities, and data retention compliance. Produce a findings list with severity. Done when no high/critical findings remain open.

tasks.name: UAT bug bash and defect triage
tasks.details: Run a structured bug bash with stakeholders against real (or realistic) data, log every finding with severity, triage into fix-now vs post-launch, and close all blockers. Done when zero launch-blocking defects remain.

tasks.name: Launch checklist and rollback plan
tasks.details: Checklist covering code freeze, migrations, backfills, data validation, access provisioning, comms, and owners. Define rollback triggers and exact steps (revert app, revert migration, restore previous dashboard version). Done when reviewed and signed off by the team lead.

tasks.name: Production deployment pipeline
tasks.details: Automate build -> test -> migration -> deploy for API, frontend and pipelines, with manual approval gate and deployment logs. Secrets injected at deploy time. Done when a tagged release deploys to prod without manual steps beyond approval.

tasks.name: Staging deployment and stakeholder UAT
tasks.details: Deploy the release candidate to staging with production-like data volumes, run the UAT script with stakeholders, and capture sign-off or issues. Done when stakeholders confirm the KPIs and screens are correct on staging.

tasks.name: Runbook, user guide and training session
tasks.details: Write the ops runbook (how to re-run a pipeline, unblock quarantine, rotate secrets, respond to alerts) and a short user guide (what each KPI means, how to filter and share). Run one 45-minute training session; record it. Done when docs are linked from the dashboard.

tasks.name: Production rollout and one-week hypercare
tasks.details: Roll out to a pilot group first, verify data freshness and KPI correctness against source for 2 days, then open to all users. Monitor alerts daily for one week, keep a fix-forward log, and hold a retrospective. Done when a week passes with no Sev-1 issues and the retro is written.

tasks.name: Design tokens and Storybook setup
tasks.details: Define design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, chart palette) and stand up Storybook locally and in CI with the token theme applied. Done when Storybook builds in CI and shows a token reference page.
